# MergeMind

> MergeMind is a GitHub Action by Cyber Global Technologies LLC that
> analyzes pull request diffs and maps code changes to SOX (ITGC),
> SOC 2 (TSC 2017) and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 controls — so audit findings
> surface before the merge, not after the deployment. For every pull
> request it generates a structured title and summary plus a risk level
> assessment (Low / Medium / High). Built for engineering, security, and
> compliance teams that need audit-aware PR reviews in GitHub Actions.
> Findings are AI-generated and informational, not an audit opinion.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://mergemind.dev): Product overview and pricing — the free tier analyzes the first 2,000 characters of each diff; a $29 one-time license per repo unlocks full-diff analysis plus the compliance stack. Both tiers run on your own OpenAI API key.
- [Privacy](https://mergemind.dev/privacy): What the CI action sends where, and the website's visit analytics + opt-out
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/gusinfosec/mergemind): Source, setup instructions, and documentation
